title: TZif rules and snapshot provenance
summary: Native TZif provider parses binary transition tables (including non-hour offsets). TimeRuleSnapshotCatalog consumes deliberately pinned immutable TZif archives. Offline tooling publishes create-only sorted manifests with SHA-256 and Adler32; native loader checks Adler32 on the exact bytes passed to the parser. That checksum is not cryptographic authentication.
invariants: Unknown/unimplemented POSIX footer recurrence must fail outside covered horizons, not assume final offset forever.
Leap-aware TZif input is rejected, not reinterpreted as ordinary POSIX seconds.
Synthetic London changed-rule fixture is NOT UK historical evidence.
Snapshot identities are provenance fields; copies of unsigned data do not imply trusted clock authority.

provenance.claim: Verified against locally inspected v0.9 package source.
